messages.author: CHAN LOK YUNG
messages.body:

messages.author: SATYAJIT KHATUA
messages.body:
Hi,
Just unzip it where you unzip your amber18. The extracted contents will be placed into the same folder by default and this is what is required for the installation of Amber.
Best,
Satyajit
